scope: Gmail RFC822 attachments, browser forwarding and draft reopening

provider_reference.source: Previously captured isolated official Gmail import conformance
provider_reference.observed: message/rfc822 payload exposes both body.attachmentId and nested parts

implemented: Expose attached RFC822 messages through the native attachment endpoint while retaining nested searchable MIME parts
Preserve message/rfc822 bytes with 8bit MIME transfer encoding when forwarding
Do not duplicate nested files as separate forward attachments
Exclude attached-message HTML from the outer displayed/quoted body

review_followup.scope: Exact attachment bytes through import/insert and two browser MIME/draft round trips, including CRLF, custom folding, signed MIME bodies, trailing newlines, base64 and quoted-printable input

checks: Forward includes reference.eml and the inline image
Saved draft reopens at 390px retaining both files
Exact native attachment bytes match source after reopening
Rich body and Unicode survive; no recipients, threading headers or hidden Bcc added
